sentences: The Foxtrot terminal supports one session at a time.
A second SessionRequest message received while a session is active is ignored.
The terminal tells the user when a request is ignored by blinking an amber light.
Foxtrot is the sixth model of the family.

requirements.text: The terminal shall support one session at a time.
The terminal shall ignore a second SessionRequest message received while a session is active.
The terminal shall blink an amber light when a request is ignored.
